propwash.help.creative_rx_block.use.1: Right-click with the radio: bind, set up.
propwash.help.creative_rx_block.use.3: Any distance, but only in its dimension.

propwash.rx.creative.tooltip: Like the RX block, but it reaches across the whole dimension.
propwash.rx.tooltip: Turns one channel of your radio into a redstone signal (0–15).
propwash.rx.foreign: This RX block is bound to %s.
propwash.rx.learn.prompt: Move the stick or switch the block should follow
propwash.rx.learn.none: Nothing moved far enough – try again or pick the channel from the list.
propwash.rx.range.label: Range
propwash.rx.link.none: No channel yet: learn one or pick it from the list.
propwash.rx.unbind.confirm: Unbind this RX block? It then follows no radio and its signal drops to 0. Anyone with a radio can bind it again.
propwash.rx.no_radio: No radio connected. The block follows a connected radio – the keyboard only while you fly.
propwash.rx.status.unbound: RX block: not bound – right-click it with your radio
propwash.guide.scene.rx_block.title: RX block: redstone by radio
propwash.guide.scene.rx_block.descriptio: One radio channel becomes a redstone signal
propwash.guide.scene.rx_block.step.place: The RX block is a receiver for redstone. Like a repeater it powers only what is in front, the way you face when placing it.
propwash.guide.scene.rx_block.callout.ou: Signal out of the front only
Right-click it with the radio: it binds to you, not to the radio, and its window opens. Only you and operators may change it.
propwash.guide.scene.rx_block.step.learn: Click “Learn channel” and move the stick or switch: throttle, a stick or an AUX switch. Then set the 0 % and 100 % points.
propwash.guide.scene.rx_block.callout.le: Move the stick that should switch
propwash.guide.scene.rx_block.step.signa: 0 % gives strength 0, 100 % gives 15. It works while you fly a drone, too – both follow the same sticks.
propwash.guide.scene.rx_block.step.range: Range up to 128 blocks, walls barely matter. Out of range the LED turns red and the block keeps its last signal.
propwash.guide.scene.rx_block.callout.ho: Out of range: keeps its signal
propwash.guide.scene.rx_block.callout.cr: Creative RX Block: no range limit in this dimension
